title: Scenario to component
summary: Read a requirement and name the components worth considering, and know that a cue isn't proof.

questions.prompt: Millions of users repeatedly load the same product images.
Users upload videos that take minutes to encode into several formats.
options: Accept the upload, queue an encoding job, and let workers process it asynchronously
Encode inside the upload request before responding
Cache the raw upload in a CDN

questions.prompt: Data and write traffic have outgrown what one database server can hold.
options: Partition (shard) the data across servers by a well-chosen key

questions.prompt: A product page is read 1,000 times for every update, and reads are too slow.
options: Cache the rendered data (cache-aside) or add read replicas

questions.prompt: Users in a chat room must see each other's messages within a second.
options: Persistent connections (WebSockets) with a pub/sub fan-out
Each client polls the server every minute

questions.prompt: A payment must never be charged twice, even if the client retries after a timeout.
options: An idempotency key stored with the charge, checked before charging
